result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: it provides requested transition, export, and migration assistance for up to six months at then-current rates, preserves the 30-day machine-readable data-return obligation, and requires secure deletion followed by written certification. The revision is narrowly focused on replacing the contradictory immediate-deletion requirement and preserves the existing data-format, metadata, fee-dispute, backup, and legal-retention protections. The drafting is clear and professionally integrated across Sections 11.1–11.3.
